_meta.scope: Shared practical website, native interface, beginner guide, and checkpoint plurals; English story bodies and detailed technical documentation are excluded.
_meta.notes: Model review is separate from human native-speaker review, rendered UI evidence, signed APK behavior, and physical-device verification. Review hashes identify content; they do not certify linguistic quality.
